blocks.orig: The Fanjove Private Island is part of the Songo Songo Archipelago, a group of five islands south of Mafia Island. The warm waters of the Indian Ocean support the diverse flora and fauna of this enchanting world, both in the water and on land. Here, the coral reefs attract many turtles that lay their eggs on the island from April to July. And on some days, schools of dolphins visit the island. You also get to spot many bird species, who use the island as a stopover on their migration route. In January, the island turns into a paradise of colors when the butterflies appear! And from May to September, you’ll have the opportunity to watch humpback whales that pass by here on their journey through the Indian Ocean. Rest assured that the scenery, as well as the wildlife, will be a treat for your eyes!
blocks.html: Fanjove Private Island belongs to the Songo Songo Archipelago, a cluster of five islands to the south of Mafia Island. The warm Indian Ocean sustains the rich flora and fauna of this enchanting world, both underwater and on land. The coral reefs draw many turtles, which come ashore to lay their eggs between April and July, and on some days pods of dolphins swim past the island. Numerous bird species can be seen too, as they use the island as a stopover on their migration route. In January the butterflies arrive and the island becomes a paradise of colour! And between May and September you have the chance to watch humpback whales passing by on their journey through the Indian Ocean. The scenery and the wildlife alike are a feast for the eyes!

blocks.orig:
The all-inclusive island offers a lot! From picnics on a sandbank, sunsets with a glass of wine on a dhow boat, kayaking and mangrove tours. You will stay at Fanjove Island’s ecobungalows – six environmentally friendly bandas made from natural materials, running on solar energy. The eco-suits are designed to make optimal use of space, energy and scenery.
With the seating area situated on the second floor and an open-concept bathroom under the stars, you get to enjoy the beauty of this island in the most intimate way. The perfect place for a couples-retreat or for a group of explorers who prefer a private, yet unique stay on one of the islands of Tanzania.
blocks.html:
This all-inclusive island has a lot to offer: picnics on a sandbank, sunset with a glass of wine aboard a dhow, kayaking and mangrove tours. Your home here is one of Fanjove Island’s ecobungalows – six environmentally friendly bandas built from natural materials and powered by the sun. The eco-suits are laid out to make the best possible use of space, energy and views.
With a seating area upstairs and an open-concept bathroom beneath the stars, you take in the island’s beauty in the most intimate way. Ideal for a couples’ retreat, or for a group of explorers after a private yet unique stay on one of Tanzania’s islands.

blocks.orig: To reach Fanjove Island, you take a small plane from Dar es Salaam to Songo Songo. This takes about 40 minutes. Your journey continues for another hour by dhow (or 20 min by speedboat) until you set foot on paradise.
blocks.html: Getting to Fanjove Island means taking a small plane from Dar es Salaam to Songo Songo, a flight of roughly 40 minutes. From there, another hour by dhow (or 20 min by speedboat) brings you to paradise.
